models.name: Piscifun Sword
models.notes: The original Sword (2015), still sold on Amazon (B017I6Y7WA, Oct 2026); piscifun.com no longer lists fly reels. Rim, width and rated capacity ('braid capacity') from Piscifun's spec image on that listing, in inches. Its widths are wider than the Sword II's and may be overall width. The 9/10 is printed as WF7F (probably a typo for WF9F; kept as printed). Spool is estimated as rim − 0.24″. Black and Gray come in fewer sizes on Amazon (Gray in 3/4 only). Black uses the base black. The foot and handle take the finish accent; the logo and drag knobs take the trim (green on Gunmetal, gray on Gray, body color otherwise).

models.name: Piscifun Sword II
models.notes: The Sword II (2020) replaced the original Sword (3/4–9/10; black, gunmetal, space gray, pink). Neither is on piscifun.com any more (both product pages 404 as of Oct 2026); specs come from Piscifun's archived Sword II page (2024–25, Wayback Machine). Rim and width converted from Piscifun's mm figures (73/21, 85/24, 93/28 mm); the same page's inch column and its spec image round differently (2.9/0.83, 3.4/0.91, 3.7/1.06 in). Rated capacity ('braid capacity', 20 lb) is Piscifun's; it gives only one line per size, so the 3/4 and 7/8 ratings are at the lighter weight. Spool is estimated as rim − 0.24″. Black uses the base black (photo samples ~#3b393b). Marked discontinued: piscifun.com no longer lists it.
